# Latent

Build your own learning platform with agents.

Latent is an opinionated, open-source framework for courses, browser IDE
lessons, flash cards, and programming practice. Portable Learning Pack sites
can be hosted independently. The included LLM Learning curriculum is the
reference implementation.

There are two extension modes:
- Portable content is untrusted declarative data authored by people or agents.
- IDE, runtime, check, UI, and persistence changes are trusted repository
  source reviewed and compiled before deployment.

The latest published Course Kit release is v0.1.0. It supports Learning Packs
with lessons, quizzes, and flash cards. Course Kit v0.2.0 is unreleased.

Programming Question Groups are a preview declarative primitive in the v0.2
source tree:
/question-groups/guide.md
/question-groups/v1/question-group-library.schema.json

Latent executes only its reviewed, bundled Question Group library:
/practice

Authoritative guide:
/open-learning/guide.md

JSON Schema:
/open-learning/learning-pack.schema.json
/open-learning/learning-feed.schema.json

Complete example:
/open-learning/reliable-llm-changes/learning-pack.json

LLM workflows:
/open-learning/skills/author-learning-pack.md
/open-learning/skills/review-learning-pack.md
/open-learning/skills/publish-learning-pack.md

Rules:
- For portable content, author only the public declarative JSON formats.
- For platform changes, modify a repository fork and use its review and
  validation gates. Do not introduce remote executable plugins.
- Cite HTTPS sources and explain how they support the material.
- Make every objective taught and assessed.
- Never place executable code, HTML, scripts, credentials, or personal data in a community pack.
- Do not treat hosted Question Group JSON as permission to execute it.
- Run strict validation before building.
- Publish the complete generated static directory without changing learning-pack.json.
- Never reuse a published package id and version for different bytes.
- Do not describe format validity as Latent review, endorsement, or certification.
